verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own docs show alert destinations: Slack notifications to any channel, PagerDuty incidents created on error activity, and alerts to team communication tools. The pack does not document the routing rules or per-rule thresholds that are the core of this story. missing for 10: email alerting, routing filters by project/environment/severity, per-rule triggers for new issue/frequency spike/affected-user count, independent or hands-on corroboration.
